premise: An ancient evil lies sleeping beneath a sleepy island town. The forest that covers the southernmost shore of the town is rumored to be the entrance to a sealed tomb. You are Mira, a grad student doing your doctoral thesis on pre-historic undead entities, and you have travelled to the forest hoping to get an interview.
scene_goal: Find and enter the pre-historic tomb.
criteria: Successfully reach the location: pre-historic tomb.

bridge_collapsed.description: The rope bridge over the nave has fallen into the water.

ferryman_paid.description: Mira has paid the Ferryman's toll.

relic_recovered.description: Mira holds the Relic of Saint Veyra.
